notes.title: Notice of Bundle Edition Release
notes.notes:
In celebration of the 4th anniversary of The Ninja Saviors: Return of the Warriors’ release, the cyborg ninjas are coming to Steam!

A 10% off bundle pack is available with "Pocky & Rocky Reshrined" to coincide with the Steam release of ”THE NINJA SAVIORS RETURN OF THE WARRIORS”!

Please purchase during this special period.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2200580/
